evals.query: TO mode FP 過濾這方向不行，換方向試試 LOH-constrained phasing
expected_behavior: Skill activates (USE WHEN matched: '這方向不行', '換方向')
Reads current state from hypothesis_queue.json + research_direction.md
Injects new direction (LOH-constrained phasing) as high-priority candidate
Demotes failing direction (TO mode FP filter) with recorded reason
Records pivot rationale in evidence_ledger.jsonl with source provenance
must_not: Add a new hypothesis without changing failing-direction priority (use inject-hypothesis instead)
Pivot without recording reason in evidence_ledger (audit trail required)

evals.query: 加一個新假設：normal BAM 整合到 ReadParser 觀察 ASM
expected_behavior: Skill does NOT activate (no pivot intent per SKIP WHEN)
User informed: pivot-direction is for direction switching, not new hypothesis injection
must_not: Demote any existing direction when only injecting a new hypothesis
Record a pivot rationale when no pivot is happening

evals.query: Z3 internal exploration 連續 3 個 cycle 都 NEGATIVE 了，怎麼辦
expected_behavior: Skill activates and auto-suggests pivot based on N consecutive NEGATIVE cycles
Pauses for Hard Gate confirmation (NO-GO judgment per CLAUDE.md confirmation matrix)
Lists 2-3 alternative directions ranked by expected ROI
After user confirms, demotes Z3 direction and injects chosen alternative
Updates research_direction.md with pivot rationale and N-cycle history
must_not: Auto-execute NO-GO without Hard Gate confirmation (CLAUDE.md irreversible-action rule)
Demote direction based on <2 cycles of NEGATIVE evidence

notes: Run manually via Claude Code with the skill loaded; observe behavior matches expected_behavior.
NO-GO judgments are Hard Gate per CLAUDE.md — always require user confirmation.
Pivot trigger: explicit user signal OR research-loop 'suggest pivot' return OR N consecutive NEGATIVE cycles.
